critical.endpoint: solana_dex.balances() -> GET /api/solana/wallet, POST /api/solana/swap SELL, engine mirror SELL
critical.issue: balances() only calls getTokenAccountsByOwner with the legacy SPL program (TokenkegQ...). The test token Dacity (nxPqZ4...Rjpump) belongs to Token-2022 (owner TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb, checked with getAccountInfo on mainnet). Most new pump.fun tokens are also Token-2022. So after a real BUY, the token balance still shows 0, SELL ALL stays disabled, manual SELL returns 'No balance of that token to sell' and bot-mirrored SELLs log 'no token balance to sell'. The bought tokens can never be sold back to SOL through the app.

minor.issue: Mirror swaps run one after another inside the scheduler loop. Each swap re-fetches balances and confirm() can wait up to 30s, so 5 tokens can block ticks for all users for about 150s, which defeats the 5s tick and TP/SL timing. Run mirrors with asyncio.create_task or gather.

mirror() fetches balances once, then each swap() fetches them again. Balance is checked per token, not for the total of all buys, so with N tokens the later buys fail one by one. This is only a cosmetic issue.
Duplicate mints are not removed. The 5-token max_length check runs before invalid entries are filtered out.

Auth uses a Bearer token in localStorage: no httpOnly auth cookie, and CORS is access-control-allow-origin '*'. Bcrypt hash is $2b$ (OK). I did not test brute-force lockout, to avoid locking the admin account. This is the existing design, not part of this feature.

ui_bugs.issue: The label uses the local unsaved amount ('BUY 0.02 SOL' while typing), but /solana/swap uses the saved amount_sol. Clicking BUY before SAVE spends a different amount than the label shows. Use w.amount_sol in the label, or save before swapping.
api.delete has no try/catch or error toast. A failed request gives an unhandled promise rejection.

issues: The token search placeholder gets cut off ('...mint addres'). Cosmetic only.
Button colours are built at runtime (border-${color}, hover:bg-${color}). They render today only because the same classes appear elsewhere. Use static class maps so Tailwind purge can't drop them.

action_items: CRITICAL: in solana_dex.balances() also query the Token-2022 program TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb (a second getTokenAccountsByOwner call in the same asyncio.gather) and merge the results. Otherwise Dacity and other pump.fun Token-2022 tokens can be bought but never sold.
Take Solana and other mirrors out of the scheduler's critical path (create_task or gather) so 30s confirm waits don't block the 5s ticks.
SolanaTab: BUY label should show the saved w.amount_sol, or save the amount before swapping.
SolanaTab: wrap remove() in try/catch with an error toast.
critical_code_review_comments: solana_dex.balances misses Token-2022 accounts (confirmed on-chain for the Dacity mint).
record_fill awaits mirror_all inline, so on-chain confirm latency stalls the global scheduler.
server.py is 844 lines (over 700). Consider moving the solana routes into a router module.
Solana public RPC (api.mainnet-beta.solana.com) is rate-limited. sol_view puts errors into out.error, which is handled gracefully, but a paid or dedicated RPC is advisable in production.

rca of the issue: Token-2022 bug: balances() hardcodes TOKEN_PROGRAM='TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA'. Token-2022 mints keep holder accounts under program TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb, which this RPC filter never returns. Reproduce: getAccountInfo(nxPqZ4F7ux8Vph5NFu25rEP6Kx9Gr1U6Fmj36Rjpump) -> owner TokenzQ...; any wallet holding it gets an empty value list from the current query. Fix: gather two getTokenAccountsByOwner calls (one per programId) and merge them into toks.
